lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance blobs posterior to the gill slits are arranged in approximately four to five visible horizontal rows. The blobs exhibit a staggered spatial distribution with increasing density and decreasing diameter towards the ventral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of lighter pigmentation intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, particularly evident in the mid-flank region. Blobs frequently occupy the center of these vertical bands, forming a loose grid-like array.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from highlight (upper) to shadow (lower) along their horizontal axes.

other_distinctive_markers: Labyrinthine or vermiculate patterns of secondary light pigmentation are visible connecting primary high-luminance blobs on the mid-posterior flank.
